title: Fiscal programs are critical to keeping Canada’s economy on track: RBC CEO
description: Dave McKay, CEO of the Royal Bank of Canada joins BNN Bloomberg to discuss how RBC is navigating the COVID-19 pandemic. He notes the unprecedented challenges will continue to cause Ottawa to act and provide further support.
